questions.question: Which statement best expresses the main message of the story?
options: Hospital workers should ignore safety rules.
Compassion can sometimes become more important than following a rule in a deeply human situation.
questions.answer: Compassion can sometimes become more important than following a rule in a deeply human situation.
questions.explanation: 文章不是主張規則都不重要，而是呈現規則與人性關懷的衝突，並凸顯 Ronald 的擁抱所產生的意義。 【出處】SOURCE：全文 Paragraphs 1–6。 常考句型整理 S + find/consider/feel/think + it + adj./N + to VR（本課句型） I found it tremendously rewarding to be able to bring some laughter to them.【重建】 The volunteer found it tremendously rewarding to help people in need. It seems/appears that + S + V（本課句型） It appeared that he was getting drowsy. It seems that he is not feeling well. 可改寫為 S + seem(s)/appear(s) + to VR，例如 He appeared to be getting drowsy. would + VR（過去習慣） When I was a child, we would visit my grandparents every weekend. bring sth. to sb. It's said that pointing at the moon with the index finger can bring bad luck to people. 不定詞作主詞補語 One of the rules of my job was never to visit the children alone. Eric's dream is to open a small café near the beach and serve homemade desserts. be permitted to VR To avoid infection, those not wearing protective clothing are not permitted to have any contact with the patients. 感官動詞 + O + V-ing / VR / p.p. I heard a voice coming from a half-open door. The little girl clapped her hands happily when she saw a teddy bear hidden under the Christmas tree. 分詞構句 After finishing my work for the day, ...（= After I finished...） "Ronald," the frail voice called, prompting me to push open the door. It is adj. (for sb.) to VR It was really heartbreaking to see such a young boy confined to a hospital bed. have no choice but to VR After the scandal was revealed, the politician had no choice but to admit what he had done and withdraw from the election. be caught + V-ing When Tony was caught cheating on the final exam, he was extremely ashamed. had + p.p.（過去完成式） Billy's mom told me her son had passed away. SOURCE 小試身手：可確定的參考答案 句型小試身手 1： Michelle is very proud of her daughter's achievement. → 答案 (B) It appears that。 說明：It appears that 後接完整子句；(A) It appears to 與 (C) Michelle seems that 的結構錯誤；(D) Michelle seems to 後面缺原形動詞（應為 Michelle seems to be very proud...）。 單字測驗：可辨識題目的參考答案 題號 答案 題號 答案 1 illnesses 7 sparkle 2 laugh

questions.question: According to the passage, why was Ronald not allowed to visit the children alone?
options: He might pass on germs to them.
He might frighten them with his painted face and red wig.
The children's parents had complained about him.
The corporation wanted to save money.
questions.answer: He might frighten them with his painted face and red wig.
questions.explanation: P2 指出 never to visit the children alone..., for I might frighten them with my painted face and red wig。傳染細菌（A）是「不可有肢體接觸」的理由，不要混淆。

questions.question: What does the narrator mean by "Some things in life, after all, were more important"?
options: He wanted to quit his job.
The hospital should remove all its rules.
Showing love and comfort to a sick child mattered more than strictly following the rules.
questions.answer: Showing love and comfort to a sick child mattered more than strictly following the rules.
questions.explanation: 敘述者在 P2 就表示理解規定背後的道理，並非認為規則無用（A、C 錯）。他的意思是，在那一刻，給病重的 Billy 一個擁抱、傳達愛與溫暖，比嚴守規定更重要。
